claims.sentence: You must submit your appeal no later than the next working day after the state final certification results are announced
You have the right to appeal the results of your thesis defense
You may submit a written appeal to the appellate commission regarding a violation of the established procedure for conducting the state final certification
You must send a scanned copy of the appeal application, which must include your signature and a transcription of your full name, to the email address education@innopolis.ru
After you submit your appeal, the ГЭК secretary forwards the case materials to the appellate commission via email

The forwarded materials include a scanned copy of the ГЭК meeting protocol, a scanned copy of the ГЭК chairman’s conclusion on procedural compliance, the defense video recording, your thesis, and the review(s) if necessary
The chairman of the appellate commission must conduct an online meeting to review your appeal no later than 2 working days after your application is submitted
The meeting is conducted via video conference using Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or similar software
The secretary of the appellate commission keeps a protocol of the meeting, and the meeting is recorded
On the day of the meeting, the chairman sends the results to the Methodological Department by emailing education@innopolis.ru with a scanned copy of the protocol
The Methodological Department then notifies you of the results via your corporate email no later than the next working day after the appellate commission meeting
The decision of the appellate commission is final and cannot be revised
If necessary, a repeated thesis defense may be conducted by the ГЭК in the presence of one appellate commission member according to the requirements of clause 2 of the regulation
An appeal against a repeated state final certification is not accepted
The evidence does not specify what constitutes a violation of the established procedure that justifies an appeal
It does not state what happens if the 2-working-day deadline for the commission meeting is missed
It does not provide details on the requirements of clause 2 mentioned for a repeated defense
It does not specify the format or content requirements for the written appeal beyond the signature and full name transcription
It does not state whether you can attend the online commission meeting or present your case
It does not clarify how the Methodological Department determines your corporate email address
